{{Top|leg}}
'''Kwenn Central''' was the bulk of the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]], just below the [[Mirrsteel Heights]]. It contained numerous hangar bays, cargo facilities, and living areas. Its exterior featured docking ports, refueling stations, and repair depots. Inside, a maze of shops, bars, [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]], and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] filled almost every habitable space.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
